applicability_test: A deterministic verifier checks if the current test failure involves a parsing assertion error where the expected key-value boundary differs from the actual boundary due to an unescaped separator being treated as a delimiter.

artifact.instruction: When parsing key-value pairs or extracting data from strings using separators, first identify all escape sequences (backslash followed by a separator) and record their byte spans. During separator matching, skip any match that falls entirely within a recorded escape sequence span to prevent premature splitting of escaped characters.
artifact.name: prompt_module

name: escape_aware_separator_parsing
postconditions: Separators are correctly identified only when they are not part of an escape sequence.
The resulting parsed data structure accurately reflects the intended key-value boundaries.
preconditions: The system is parsing structured data (e.g., CLI arguments, JSONP wrappers) using regex or string splitting based on specific separators.
The input string may contain escaped separators (e.g., 'key\\:value' where ':' is the separator).
